# Operations

- OPS-003: Every HttpClient gets the standard resilience handler (timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breaker) from the ServiceDefaults project, retrying only safe methods; a client that needs other settings removes the default handler (RemoveAllResilienceHandlers, experimental: suppress EXTEXP0001 with a reason) before adding its own.
